description:
Goal

One source callable construction owns one runtime object and one producer-correlated member plan. Exact calls may use private ABIs; every indirect call consumes only the object's public ABI. Root packaging contains closed physical contracts. No layer reconstructs semantic or physical evidence from keys, positions, Ty summaries, World scans, or sibling inventories.

Clarified domains

- Ty is the authoritative abstract value domain. Closure literals are value alternatives: they carry target and capture Tys; intersection specializes them, union preserves alternatives, and callable_value_clauses is their legitimate eliminator. A parallel provenance lattice would duplicate this domain and can diverge from it.
- CallableDemand is consumer use: observed call surfaces plus first-class/opaque escape. Producer callable clauses are supply. Supply must never be converted into use.
- ActivationKey is bounded identity. ActivationSeed is a refinement fact: key plus precise input evidence. Key inputs are not evidence once convergence collapse applies.
- Callable flow combines authoritative producer supply with actual consumer use. It yields producer-correlated activation seeds. Transport may project this relation but may not recreate it.

Proven first losses

1. type_derived_flow_resolutions projects a producer value's callable Ty into demand-cone use before consumer use exists.
2. closure_callee_demand and CallableFlowBuilder retain call surfaces without exact resolution where a CallTargetSummary already owns one.
3. callable_flow_resolution_edges_product constructs a precise input vector, mints a key, then CallableFlowEdge retains only the ExecutableKey.
4. SeedActivation recreates ActivationInputs with activation.inputs(). This is invalid by construction because the key is convergence-collapsed.
5. ground_surface_for_template_in_session scans sibling executables and selects a fitting instantiation. This is global reverse engineering, not refinement.
6. Packaging historically repeated the same error with symbolic positions and consumer-position identity.

Spike proof

- take_every: 3 surfaces -> 1 exact activation -> 1 physical shape row. No selection is necessary.
- drop_while: 3 surfaces -> 2 current activations. Type-derived cone seeding predicts only the :true target and misses the mixed target.
- Removing type-derived Phase B loses five first-class reducer targets: split_positive x2, split_with, split_while, and drop_while.
- Flat key expansion and retained-demand expansion both find those five targets but lose the nested x < 4 predicate.
- Exact comparison proves why: every relevant minted seed differs from key.inputs(). drop_while lambda74 carries the closure union #73/#75/#76/#88 while its key contains bare a0; split_while and split_with show the same loss. split_positive also loses concrete nested list state to address variables.
- Ty already carries those closure alternatives. No additional provenance is missing.
- Root Region::Type questions cannot observe nested distinctions that full Ty retains. Backend capability to synthesize structural questions is not authority to do so.
- An unused callable input has supply but no callable use. It must remain omitted; supply alone cannot activate its body.

Construction strategy

1. Introduce one shared ActivationSeed { key, inputs } at the semantic identity boundary. Replace private ActivationContribution and every latent key-only seed with it.
2. Carry exact CallTargetSummary resolutions through direct callable use. Carry unresolved/public surfaces separately.
3. Resolve producer clauses only against actual observed use. Preserve the resulting ActivationSeed through callable flow and demand-cone growth.
4. Settle demand graph membership and callable-use ascent as one monotone fixpoint. Delete type_derived_flow_resolutions after the exact-seed spike proves the five targets and nested predicate.
5. Delete SeedActivation input reconstruction, ground_surface_for_template_in_session, activation.inputs fallbacks, and duplicate target/surface reconstructions.
6. Collapse same-seed members before transport. If distinct keys have no preserved runtime observation, collapse the activation identity upstream; never synthesize patterns from Ty.
7. Re-evaluate runtime_envelope and callable Region::Type only after reconstructed dispatch is gone. Keep only a forward runtime-observable abstraction; remove compensating conversions.

Physical model retained from prior work

- CallableFlowFact owns function, captures, member resolutions, input mappings, direct/public uses, and consumer-owned result demand.
- TransportLayout is structural shape plus carrier; Nothing cannot carry ValueRef.
- BackendValueLayout closes shape, carrier, tys, and reprs. BackendReturnLayout adds divergence.
- Positions end at RootBackendProduct. Indirect edges carry sealed return flow like direct/dispatch edges.
- Public return is Diverges, Absent, or ValueRef from settled consumer demand across all members.
- Distinct source constructions remain distinct objects when joined. Construction identity is allocation-only.

Test intent

Keep behavior, producer ownership, allocation-only identity, exact/direct versus public boundaries, consumer-owned return carrier, sealed indirect flow, and no packaged symbolic positions. Replace exact counts and forced specialization plurality with set membership and monotone upper bounds. Treat fewer activations, members, shapes, captures, events, and allocations as improvements unless behavior or an owned boundary requires them.

Acceptance

- No target or input evidence is reconstructed from callable Ty supply alone, ActivationKey, TransportPosition, semantic return type, World/sibling scans, or first-member layouts.
- Unused callbacks remain unactivated and omitted.
- Enum operator-ref/take/drop/split/search, Range, opaque ignored/consumed controls, recursive controls, resource controls, interpreter, JIT, and CLI behavior pass.
- Runtime selection contains only distinctions backed by a preserved observation.
- Packaged/native types contain no TransportPosition or symbolic ABI inputs.
- Full library and strict clippy pass except only the separately-owned raw telemetry handler baselines.
- Release fixture 00181 emits no diagnostics and telemetry remains near the proven 1,114-record envelope.

comments.text: Refinement-only model correction: downstream must never infer or reverse-engineer an observable discriminator from Ty. Preserve an authoritative observation witness forward, or collapse targets where they diverge. Real-fixture spikes found zero direct-callsite runtime-predicate collisions. Callable construction edges do collide, but exact {[], int} vs {[int], int} edges resolve to the same executable and must not motivate dispatch. Remaining split-family distinct targets have identical transported shapes; drop_while differs only in boolean lane identity while retaining the same tuple structure. Structural DispatchMatrix capability is therefore not proof of necessity. Current lead: DispatchDemand is forward-derived from EntryDispatch and convergence-collapse is the existing key abstraction, but CallableSurface/CallableFlowEdge retain only Ty surfaces. Prove whether ignored tuple-union correlation and scalar literals should collapse at key formation; do not synthesize patterns later.

Proven refinement boundary from the real Enum fixture:

- CallTargetSummary already owns the authoritative pair (surface_inputs, exact activation).
- closure_callee_demand discards target.activation and retains only surface_inputs. CallableDemand and CallableFlowBuilder then transport surfaces without their resolution.
- callable_flow_resolution_edges_product later calls world.activation_key over producer captures plus those surfaces, reconstructing the discarded target relation.
- take_every exposes 3 transported surfaces, all belonging to 1 exact activation and 1 physical shape row. They must collapse; there is no dispatch decision.
- drop_while exposes 3 transported surfaces belonging to 2 exact activations and 2 shape rows. The downstream closure CallTargetSummary facts contain both targets. Type-derived cone seeding reconstructs only the :true target and misses the mixed :false|:true target, while settled flow contains both. Reconstruction is therefore both unnecessary and incomplete.
- The owner activation has no local lambda CallTargetSummary because invocation occurs downstream. Exact target evidence must flow backward through callable demand/value joins to the producer; the producer must refine that preserved relation into its flow fact, never parse Ty or recompute activation.
- Direct exact resolutions and unresolved/public surfaces are distinct domains. Exact calls preserve CallTargetSummary edges. A first-class public surface may be combined with authoritative producer identity to resolve a target for the first time. Do not put both into one resolved surface set.
- Delete the synthetic pattern-from-Ty spike direction. Dispatch capability is not proof that a discriminator is necessary.

Next spike gates before implementation: prove direct CallSiteSummary closure over the whole demand cone already includes the target members currently added by type_derived_flow_resolutions; delete the type-derived phase disposably and observe membership/fixpoint behavior. Then TDD a split CallableDemand/CallableFlowBuilder model that carries exact direct resolutions and only resolves genuinely public surfaces at the producer.

title: fz-k22: preserve producer callable constructions behind one public indirect ABI
